title: Neapolitan Buffalo Margherita
source: AVPN / EU STG Margherita rules, Mangieri, Modernist Pizza, Kenji, Baking Steel

items.body: Cut the mozzarella and drain it in a sieve over paper towels, uncovered, in the fridge. Pat dry before using. Out of the fridge 30 min before baking.
Drain the tomatoes 10 min. Trim stem ends and any skin. Crush by hand into small pieces; don’t blend (broken seeds turn bitter). Weigh 300 g and stir in the salt. Nothing else. Use at room temp.

T − 1 h: steel on the top rack, its surface ≈4 in below the broiler (no closer than 3 in). Stone on the lowest rack. Oven to 550 °F (288 °C) for a full hour; broil on high the last 5–10 min. The steel should read ≈600–650 °F.
Flour the ball. Press with fingertips from the center out, pushing air to the edge; leave a 1 in rim untouched. Flip, repeat. Stretch over the backs of your hands to 11–12 in. Never press the rim.

ings.name: Olive oil, extra-virgin
ings.note: 5 g before, 2.5 g after per pie

items.body: On the peel: 75 g sauce in a spiral, rim bare; 3 basil leaves; 5 g oil in a spiral. Launch under the lit broiler; close the door.

Rotate 180° at ≈1 min. At ≈2½ min, when the rim has puffed and set, pull it onto the peel. Scatter 90 g bufala. Back under the broiler until just melted and the rim is leopard-spotted, 1½–2 min. Top racing ahead of the bottom? Broiler off for the last minute.
Finish with 2 fresh basil leaves and 2.5 g raw oil. Serve at once. Broil 5–7 min between pies to reheat the steel.

nutritionSource: Mutti San Marzano PDO label (FDC 1144271); Il Villaggio Bufala Campana DOP label (FDC 1884913) as the DOP reference; Morton; SR Legacy (basil, olive oil). Dough from its card. Peel dusting not counted.
notes: Use true DOP tomatoes: look for the Consorzio seal and a numbered strip. Cento “Certified San Marzano” is not DOP.
This is the best Neapolitan a home oven makes (2–4 min). For the real 60–90 s pie, the upgrade is an Effeuno P134HA: ≈950 °F, 240 V, AVPN-approved, indoors.
